step1_analysis.circuit_type: Multiple-input boost circuit / Negative voltage generator
step1_analysis.description: A capacitive voltage combiner using MOS capacitors (XM2-XM4) and a diode-connected NMOS (XM1) for DC restoration. It generates a negative voltage spike at the output (VO) when the inputs transition from high to low, which is used to dynamically drive the bulk terminal of other devices in Bulk Input Differential Logic (BIDL).

paper_reference.title: Design and Application of CMOS Bulk Input Scheme

v_out_min.description: Minimum output voltage (negative boost voltage) achieved during the low phase of the inputs.

sky130_expected.calculation: Coupling ratio = C_inputs / (C_inputs + C_xm1) = 75fF / 100fF = 0.75. Voltage swing = 1.8V * 0.75 = 1.35V. V_max is clamped at Vth (~0.5V). V_min = V_max - Swing = 0.5V - 1.35V = -0.85V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on exact parasitic capacitances and the threshold voltage of the diode-connected NMOS.

v_out_max.description: Maximum output voltage, clamped by the diode-connected NMOS.

sky130_expected.calculation: Clamped by XM1 (diode-connected NMOS to GND). V_max ≈ Vth of NMOS.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Vth of sky130 NMOS is around 0.42V, but can be slightly higher due to dynamic overshoot before the diode fully turns on.

power.description: Dynamic power consumption of the boost circuit at 1 GHz.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Power is dominated by charging and discharging the MOS capacitors at the 1 GHz operating frequency.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the negative boost voltage and power consumption with 1 GHz input pulses.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Multiple-Input Boost Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 VO VO GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VO V1 VO VO sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VO V2 VO VO sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VO V3 VO VO sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* 1 GHz input pulses
V1 V1 GND PULSE(0 1.8 0 50p 50p 450p 1n)
V2 V2 GND PULSE(0 1.8 0 50p 50p 450p 1n)
V3 V3 GND PULSE(0 1.8 0 50p 50p 450p 1n)

.control
tran 10p 20n

* Measure min and max output voltages in steady state
meas tran v_out_min min v(VO) from=10n to=20n
meas tran v_out_max max v(VO) from=10n to=20n

* Calculate dynamic power consumption
let pwr1 = -i(V1)*v(V1)
let pwr2 = -i(V2)*v(V2)
let pwr3 = -i(V3)*v(V3)
let pwr_total = pwr1 + pwr2 + pwr3
meas tran avg_power avg pwr_total from=10n to=20n

print v_out_min v_out_max avg_power
quit
.endc
